title: AITA? My husband of 4 months gets sent to prison for a year while I travel with friends
question: AITA? My husband of 4 months gets sent to prison for a year while I travel with friends
body:
So, my husband of 4 months loses his case and gets sent to prison for a little over a year.  This is a very difficult situation for both of us.  I’m super stressed and the way I handle stress is to travel.  So I wrote him telling him that I was going to Disneyland for the day with a guy friend who is coworker (he has never met him).  Then I wrote to tell him that I booked an all inclusive trip to a beach in Thailand with my GF, nothing crazy going on, just some shopping, snorkeling and chillin on the beach.  I also went to Colorado and Utah for skiing trips with my GFs and I have an upcoming trip to Japan to visit my mom in a couple of months.  
He is freaking out and was like I thought travel was something we would do together.  He asked me if the situation was on the other foot how I would feel?  I asked him what was I supposed to do while he was gone?  Just sit around and be miserable?  So am I the asshole here?
